name: Atomic Color Averaging in Voxelization
definition: A method to average fragment colors in a voxel texture using integer atomic operations because floating-point atomics are not available by default for RGB textures.
summary: Atomic Color Averaging is a GPU technique that resolves race conditions during parallel voxelization by using integer atomic compare-and-swap operations to incrementally compute average colors, avoiding the need for floating-point atomics.
